plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the UX of the WeaveAPI developer documentation, focusing on navigation, interactive code examples, the try-it panel, and responsive layout behaviors.
plan.summary: The exploration will proceed through the primary developer onboarding flow, starting with the home and quickstart pages, then deep-diving into the interactive Charges API try-it panel and adjacent resource pages. It will validate error states, search functionality, and dark mode, before concluding with a focused mobile viewport review to address layout warnings and tap targets.
assumptions: The try-it panel on charges.html is the most complex interactive component and will yield the most significant UX insights.
The search input (ctrl+K) triggers a modal or inline search experience that needs validation.
The dark mode toggle (🌙) applies globally and persists or affects layout/styling across pages.
Horizontal overflow warnings on charges.html, customers.html, and webhooks.html indicate potential responsive design flaws, likely around code blocks or tables.
risk_hotspots: charges.html try-it panel: invalid currency error handling and parameter syncing on scroll
charges.html, customers.html, webhooks.html: horizontal overflow issues on desktop
Global: small tap targets (223x31px) on left navigation links for mobile viewports
Search input: discoverability, interaction, and results navigation

phases.title: Onboarding & Home Flow
phases.objective: Validate the initial landing experience, global navigation, and quickstart guide.
key_checks: Verify left nav and right anchor links work correctly on index.html
Test code block language toggles (CURL, PYTHON, NODE, GO) and copy buttons
Navigate to quickstart.html and validate the two-step example flow
Test the dark mode toggle for visual consistency
exit_criteria: All index.html sections scrolled and anchor links verified
Quickstart page fully read and code interactions tested

phases.title: Interactive API Try-It Panel
phases.objective: Deeply validate the interactive try-it panel on the Charges API page, including success and error states.
key_checks: Scroll through Charge object and endpoints to verify right-column try-it panel syncs correctly
Fill valid parameters (e.g., currency=usd) in try-it panel and send to verify mock success response
Fill invalid parameters (e.g., currency=xyz) to trigger currency_not_supported error and validate error UX
Check horizontal overflow warning on desktop viewport
Test code block toggles and copy buttons for multiple endpoints
exit_criteria: Try-it panel tested for at least 2 different endpoints
Both success and error mock responses observed

phases.title: Adjacent Resources & Webhooks
phases.objective: Explore the remaining core resource pages and webhook documentation for consistency and completeness.
key_checks: Verify Customers API object table and endpoint code blocks render correctly
Check Webhooks event types table and signature verification code blocks
Investigate horizontal overflow warnings on both pages
Validate right-column anchor navigation syncs while scrolling
exit_criteria: Customers and Webhooks pages fully scrolled and inspected
Code copy and toggle interactions verified

phases.title: Error Reference & Search
phases.objective: Validate the error codes reference page and the global search functionality.
key_checks: Review error codes table for readability and handling hints
Click into errors.html from index.html 'Full list →' link
Trigger search via input field and ctrl+K shortcut
Validate search results UI, keyboard navigation, and link accuracy
exit_criteria: Search opened via both input click and keyboard shortcut

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Repeat critical checks on a mobile viewport to assess responsive design and tap target issues.
key_checks: Verify left nav collapses or adapts properly on mobile
Check small tap targets (223x31px) on navigation links for usability
Test try-it panel layout and interaction on mobile for charges.html
Validate code block readability and horizontal scrolling on mobile
exit_criteria: Try-it panel used successfully on mobile

coverage_targets.features: exercise all interactive controls: try-it panel, code toggles, copy buttons, dark mode, search, and nav links
coverage_targets.mobile: validate critical flows (nav, try-it panel, code blocks) on mobile viewport to assess layout warnings

notes: Pay special attention to the try-it panel's scrolling sync behavior, as this is a complex UX pattern.
Document any visual glitches when toggling dark mode, especially around code blocks and tables.
Note whether the horizontal overflow warnings on desktop are caused by code blocks, tables, or the try-it panel.

prescan_summary.title: WeaveAPI — Threads of value, woven simple
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Accept your first payment in 5 minutes. WeaveAPI is a payments-as-an-API platform built for backend engineers who want to ship value capture without inheriting a banking compliance department. Quickstart The most basic flow: collect a payment method, create a charge, capture funds. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl -X POST https://api.weave.dev/v1/charges \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc" \ -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \ -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd -d payment_method=pm_card_visa Copy Authentication WeaveAPI uses API keys. Test keys are prefixed sk_test_; live keys are sk_live_. Send your key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. CURL PYTHON NODE GO curl https:

prescan_summary.title: Errors — WeaveAPI
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Error codes All WeaveAPI errors are returned as a structured object. Use code for programmatic handling and message for display. CODE HTTP MESSAGE HOW TO HANDLE card_declined 402 The card was declined Surface a retry; offer alternate payment method insufficient_funds 402 Insufficient funds on the card Retry with a different method expired_card 402 The card has expired Prompt user to update the card incorrect_cvc 402 CVC check failed Re-ask for the CVC processing_error 502 Issuer was unreachable Safe to retry with idempotency key fraud_blocked 402 Blocked by our risk system Do not retry; escalate via dashboard three_d_secure_required 402 3DS authentication required Redirect to three_d_secure.url

prescan_summary.title: Webhooks — WeaveAPI
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: WeaveAPI GETTING STARTED Quickstart Authentication Idempotency Pagination CORE RESOURCES Charges Customers PAYMENT METHODS Cards Bank Wallets WEBHOOKS Events Verifying Retries ERRORS Error codes 🌙 Webhooks WeaveAPI sends HTTP POST callbacks to your endpoint when interesting events happen. Each event is signed; verify before processing. Event types EVENT DESCRIPTION charge.succeeded A charge transitioned to succeeded charge.failed A charge transitioned to failed charge.refunded Full or partial refund applied charge.disputed Buyer opened a dispute charge.dispute.closed Dispute resolved (won or lost) customer.created New customer record customer.updated Customer attributes changed customer.deleted Customer was deleted payment_method.attached PM linked to a customer payment_method.detached PM unlinked invoice.created New invoice generated invoice.finalized Invoice is no longer draft invoice.
